shouldFix.title: authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate drops thirteen frozen fixture directories that remain on disk
shouldFix.promptAttack: authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate dropped frozen fixture directories that exist on disk
evidence: The frozen, recorded, dual-ACCEPT v19 predecessor enumerates nineteen non-mutation paths. A set difference against v20 returns thirteen deletions and one correct addition, fixtures/g21.v16/.
Every deleted path still resolves to a directory on disk at review time; this is not cleanup of absent paths.
The review prompt names omission of existing frozen fixture directories as an explicit attack. The candidate therefore does not refute that attack.
No protected fixture byte was observed to move or change, so the defect is the candidate's incomplete custody disclosure rather than a payload-byte corruption.
shouldFix.impact: A recorded successor would weaken the frozen-tree custody surface and make thirteen extant historical fixture directories disappear from the candidate's explicit non-mutation accounting, despite the immediately preceding frozen corpus retaining them.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The omission does not change the sole new fixture, its digest, its semantics, the remainder measurement, a readiness status, or any protected bytes. It is a current-subject custody and honesty defect, so SHOULD-FIX is sufficient to reject under the prompt's verdict rule.
shouldFix.requiredRemedy: In a frozen successor, restore the thirteen exact predecessor paths to authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate while retaining docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/g21.v16/. Do not edit this frozen candidate, any predecessor, or any fixture bytes.

reviewSummary: REJECT at 0 MUST-FIX and 1 SHOULD-FIX. The subject and fixture reproduce their expected hashes and modes; the fixture is exactly the closed four-byte big-endian unsigned value 4294967295 with no body and does not reuse the v11 or v16 prefix values. All twenty file-backed recorded inputs match live bytes, HEAD and file 08 match, D-347 is the sole last-heading claimant, required-now remains 28, OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remains open, prefix exactly at the operative bound remains unauthored, and the protected joins are not remasured. Rejection is solely for deleting thirteen still-present frozen directories from authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate relative to frozen v19.
